title: Transfer of Managed Establishments Amendment Act 1992

sections.shortTitle: Transfer of Managed Establishments Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 1992
ACT V OF 1992
TRANSFER OF
MANAGED ESTABLISHMENTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the Transfer of Managed Establishments Order, 1978
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 16th April, 1992]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 13th
April, 1992, and is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Transfer of Managed
Establishments (Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Transfer of Managed Establishments Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Amendment of Article 4, P.O. No.12 of 1978

ACT V OF 1992
ACT V OF 1992
TRANSFER OF
MANAGED ESTABLISHMENTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the Transfer of Managed Establishments Order, 1978
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 16th April, 1992]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 13th
April, 1992, and is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of Article 4,
P.O. No.12 of 1978.----.In the Transfer of Managed Establishment Order,
1978 (P.O.No.12 of 1978), in Article 4,--
(i) in clause (2), for the full
stop at the end a colon shall be substituted and thereafter the following
proviso shall be added, namely:--
"Provided that it shall not
be necessary to make such an offer to the persons specified in the Schedule in
case the highest bid has been made by the employees of the managed
establishment."; and
(ii) in clause (3), after the
brackets and figure "(2)'", the words "within a specified
time" shall be inserted.
